# Claropack - Professional Beverage Packaging Manufacturer

> Verified high-clarity PET cups, hard injection PP cups, and custom logo printing service.

## Core Capabilities
- **Low MOQ Custom Printing**: Starts from 1,000 pieces per size.
- **One-Stop Supply**: Comprehensive range of cups, lids, sealing films, and accessories.
- **Global Standards**: Focused on 90mm, 95mm, 98mm, and 107mm calibers.

## Product Lines
- **PET Cold Cups**: 3oz to 32oz, crystal clear, food-grade PET resin.
- **Injection PP Cups**: 360ml to 960ml, heat-resistant up to 100°C, round and square formats.
- **Lids & Accessories**: Snap-Lock PET lids, rigid injection lids, and custom-printed sealing film.
